snippet.title: Bonelords - Indev Trailer
snippet.description:
Build up yourself & your defenses in Bonelords! Defend against waves of enemies! Attack using a large variety of weapons & tools! Scale your power, and face the great hordes of Spegroon!

This is a game I am currently working on. Currently in Pre-Apha / Indev.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1996550/Bonelords/
